ModMetaData.name: Iranian Rugs (for VFE - Art)
ModMetaData.author: MythraPS
ModMetaData.description:
Turns Vanilla Furniture Expanded - Art's small, large and grand rugs into Iranian-style hand-knotted rugs. Each size has several designs - medallion, lattice, garden panels, prayer arch, boteh rows and vase - and each rug you build picks one at random.
The main colour of the rug is still the colour of the cloth or leather it is made from; borders and motifs add fixed colours. Names, sizes, costs, beauty and recipes are unchanged.
Requires Vanilla Furniture Expanded - Art.
Current version: v1.1.0
